description: Every Evidence Receipt vector in this directory, with the outcome a conformant verifier must reach. Negative vectors name the normative rule that must fire. The `policy` block is the locally configured trust policy the outcomes assume (receipt format §1 design rule 1); it is deliberately NOT derived from any receipt.
